LESSON: COMPONENTS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports
Topic 1.2: Components of Creative Arts and Sports
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Components of Creative Arts and Sports, part of Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How does one create harmony in pictorial composition? 2. Why should athletes avoid performance enhancers to develop physical fitness?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Components of Creative Arts and Sports together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: The learner articulates and shares their understanding of various creative arts genres with peers and

educators.

● Learning to Learn: The learner engages in independent research to understand the unique aspects of Creative Arts and Sports genres.

8

● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: The learner engages in analysis of components and their roles in Creative Arts and Sports.

Values

● Unity: The learner strengthens teamwork as they collaboratively research and do presentations on the components of Creative Arts and

Sports.

● Citizenship: The learner shares knowledge on contemporary music from different parts of the world.

● Mental Health: Learners participate in Creative Arts and Sports performances for fun and enjoyment to promote mental health and

● Identifying and nurturing of gifts and talents: The learner identifies different components of Creative Arts and Sports.

Link to other learning areas:

Mathematics: The learner interacts with mathematical patterns to create rhythm in music.
